iterations.plan: Implement Hangul decomposition by mapping syllable indices to compatibility jamo using predefined lists.
iterations.code:
def decompose(text: str) -> str:
    # Compatibility Jamo tables
    INITIALS = [
        'ㄱ','ㄲ','ㄴ','ㄷ','ㄸ','ㄹ','ㅁ','ㅂ','ㅃ','ㅅ',
        'ㅆ','ㅇ','ㅈ','ㅉ','ㅊ','ㅋ','ㅌ','ㅍ','ㅎ'
    ]
    VOWELS = [
        'ㅏ','ㅐ','ㅑ','ㅒ','ㅓ','ㅔ','ㅕ','ㅖ','ㅗ','ㅘ',
        'ㅙ','ㅚ','ㅛ','ㅜ','ㅝ','ㅞ','ㅟ','ㅠ','ㅡ','ㅢ','ㅣ'
    ]
    FINALS = [
        '',   'ㄱ','ㄲ','ㄳ','ㄴ','ㄵ','ㄶ','ㄷ','ㄹ','ㄺ',
        'ㄻ','ㄼ','ㄽ','ㄾ','ㄿ','ㅀ','ㅁ','ㅂ','ㅄ','ㅅ',
        'ㅆ','ㅇ','ㅈ','ㅊ','ㅋ','ㅌ','ㅍ','ㅎ'
    ]

    result = []

    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        # Hangul syllable block range
        if 0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3:
            s_index = code - 0xAC00
            l = s_index // (21 * 28)
            v = (s_index % (21 * 28)) // 28
            t = s_index % 28

            result.append(INITIALS[l])
            result.append(VOWELS[v])
            if t:
                result.append(FINALS[t])
        else:
            result.append(ch)

    return ''.join(result)
